description: Northwest Association of Networked Ocean Observing Systems | An IOOS Regional Data Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA - Integrated Ocean Observing System. The Northwest Association of Networked Ocean Observing Systems (NANOOS) represents an amalgamation of 65 separate products available for decision makers' use. This toolkit was created to unite the vast amount of individual pre-existing observing systems like ocean buoys, satellites, and tide gauges into one network to improve communication between the systems. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
